acme-sre: Hey — since this morning our CI service account (svc-acme-deploy) can't access the project console. Getting 403 on the UI and API. Started right after our IdP (Okta) rotation. Logs below.

acme-sre: ```curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.ai/projects/acme
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"access_denied","message":"project:view denied"}
```

acme-sre: Decoded token claims (sanitized): `{ "iss": "https://okta.example.com", "sub": "00u1abcdefg", "groups": ["acme-deployers"], "scopes": ["console:read"] }` — previously sub had format `svc:acme:deploy:123`.

Amira (Support): Sorry about that — investigating. Can you paste how the svc account is provisioned (federated service account vs native) and when it last worked?

acme-sre: Last worked ~2024-12-07T05:30Z. IdP rotation ~2024-12-07T04:50Z. The SA is federated, mapped via SCIM group `acme-deployers`. SCIM resync at 05:10 showed no obvious errors in our IDP logs.

Miguel (Identity): Quick hypothesis: looks like the IdP changed the `sub` claim format (e.g., moved from a long service identifier to Okta user id). If our identity mapping anchors on `sub`, that will orphan the federated identity and inherited role bindings drop -> 403. Can you send the token `external_id`/email field? Also confirm if this is a federated service account (not a Redwood-native service account).

acme-sre: Token snippet: ```{ "iss": "https://okta.example.com", "sub": "00u1abcdefg", "email": "svc-acme-deploy@acme.com", "groups": ["acme-deployers"], "scp": ["console:read"] }``` — yes, federated.

Amira (Support): Thanks. That matches Miguel's theory. Workaround options: 1) add an explicit project role binding to svc-acme-deploy@acme.com (fast), or 2) re-link the service account in Console -> Admin -> Service accounts (safer). We'll escalate to Identity to re-run the mapping using `email`/external_id so the SA isn't orphaned after future rotations.

Tomas (Infra): @Miguel can you check SCIM/group-sync logs for the `acme-deployers` delta around 05:00-06:00Z? If mapping broke, we can re-associate by matching on email or external_id. I'll open an ops ticket for a manual rebind if needed.

Miguel (Identity): On it. Capturing relevant logs: request-id r-9f4a2c, token kid=ab12cd. Immediate recommendation: add a temporary explicit binding `project.viewer` to svc-acme-deploy@acme.com to restore console/API access while we investigate. We'll follow with a PR to make identity mapping tolerant of sub-format changes.

acme-sre: Applying binding now... ok, access restored, console loads and API calls succeed. Thanks! Please keep me posted on permanent fix and any postmortem.

Amira (Support): Great — leaving this thread open to track root cause. Next steps: Miguel to confirm SCIM drift root cause and push tolerant-parser fix (ETA EOW). Tomas to confirm ops ticket status. I'll draft a short postmortem once we have the timeline.

sre-bot: Incident logged: INC-2401239876. Assigned: Miguel (Identity). Priority: P2.
